segments.verbatim_es: Lo que pasa, lo explico nuevamente para que me entiendan, las personas que están a cargo del proceso, para hablar en general, las personas que están a cargo del proceso indican que cierta persona no CORRIO con los procesos, nosotros vamos y le explicamos que tiene que SEGUIR con los procesos porque no puede estar el aeronave porque no SEGUIO cierto proceso, y usted no puede estar lamentablemente en el aeronave porque tiene que SEGUIR todos los procesos....... DEJAME TERMINAR, ASI FUNCIONA: y luego posteriormente si usted no quiere descender, el capitán da la orden de que decienda, y posteriormente como usted vio, viene una persona de seguridad y lo descendió, en base a lo que se le estaba indicando que usted no cumplió, ahora si usted me dice que eso es todo incorrecto, que usted CUMPLIO, que usted lo hizo todo bien, ahora que está policía en el caso, va a ver la situación, va a corroborar la verdad y va a dar la solución que corresponda, si efectivamente usted tiene la razón en todo, usted no va a ser afectado, después va a poder tomar... Yo ya estoy afectado. No, pero como le digo, me refiero a algo legal, y después va a tomar la medida del caso, y creo que le corresponde a usted por verse afectado en la medida que usted me está diciendo.
segments.translation_en: What happens is — let me explain again so you understand — the people in charge of the process, speaking generally, the people in charge of the process indicate that a certain person did NOT FOLLOW the procedures. We go and explain to you that you must FOLLOW the procedures because you cannot be on the aircraft because you did NOT FOLLOW a certain procedure, and unfortunately you cannot be on the aircraft because you must FOLLOW all the procedures… LET ME FINISH, THIS IS HOW IT WORKS: and then subsequently if you do not want to deplane, the captain gives the order for you to deplane, and then as you saw, a security person comes and deplaned you, based on what you were being told — that you did not comply. Now, if you tell me that all of this is incorrect, that you DID COMPLY, that you did everything right — now that the police are on the case, they will look at the situation, corroborate the truth, and provide the appropriate resolution. If indeed you are right about everything, you will not be affected; afterwards you will be able to take… [Passenger: I am already affected.] No, but as I say, I mean something legal, and afterwards the appropriate measure will be taken, and I believe it falls to you, given that you have been affected in the way you are telling me.
segments.transcription_notes: Speaker is DGAC official. Passage shows DGAC uncritically relaying the carrier's version of events ('the people in charge of the process indicate…') rather than conducting an independent regulatory assessment, then deferring resolution entirely to police.; reanchored from STG-7.seg-22 (method=text+offset, confidence=high, text_ratio=1.0)

segments.verbatim_es: quando tu le diga que no hay ninguna agression como hai visto en la camara y todo eso..
segments.translation_en: When you tell them that there was no aggression, as you have seen on the camera and all that…
segments.transcription_notes: Speaker is PDI officer. Phonetic/informal spelling in original ('quando', 'hai'). Statement acknowledges that CCTV review showed no aggression, undermining the carrier's stated basis for removal — yet DGAC took no corrective action.; reanchored from STG-7.seg-44 (method=text+offset, confidence=high, text_ratio=1.0)

segments.verbatim_es: Ya Leandro, ja voy dar el parte de la direcion general de aeronautica, lamentamos que tenga perdido tu vuelo, que esta decicion no la decidimos nosotros
segments.translation_en: Alright Leandro, I am going to issue the report from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation. We regret that you lost your flight; this decision was not made by us.
segments.transcription_notes: Speaker attribution uncertain (PDI or DGAC). Phonetic/informal spelling ('ja voy', 'direcion', 'decicion'). The statement explicitly disclaims DGAC's decisional role, evidencing abdication of the oversight authority vested in the agency.; reanchored from STG-7.seg-75 (method=text+offset, confidence=high, text_ratio=1.0)

segments.translation_en: Both accusations were confirmed [to be false]. Please confirm that with the PDI.
